name: Minecraft: Dream it, Build it!
description:
Dive into an open world of building, crafting and survival. Gather resources, survive the night, and build whatever you can imagine one block at a time. Explore and craft your way through a completely open world where you can play with friends, build a city, start a farm, mine deep into the ground, face mysterious enemies, or just experiment to the limits of your imagination! 
 
The possibilities are endless. Embark on an epic adventure and play with friends, building from the ground up. Build and expand in Creative mode, where you can craft from unlimited resources. Survive the night, face intense battles, craft tools, and fend off danger in Survival mode. With seamless cross-platform and multiplayer gameplay on Minecraft: Bedrock Edition, you can adventure solo or with friends, and discover an infinite, randomly generated world filled with blocks to mine, biomes to explore, and mobs to befriend (or battle)!  
 
In Minecraft, the world is yours to shape! 
 
CREATE YOUR WORLD 
• Build anything from the ground up 
• Craft from special resources and tools to create brand new structures and landscapes 
• Explore an endless open world full of different biomes and creatures 
• Minecraft Marketplace – Get creator-made add-ons, thrilling worlds, and stylish cosmetics on Minecraft Marketplace 
• Connect with millions of players on community servers, or subscribe to Realms Plus to cross-play with up to 10 friends on your own private server 
• Slash commands – Tweak how the game plays: you can change the weather, summon mobs, change the time of day, and more 
• Add-ons – Customize your experience even further with add-ons! If you're more tech-inclined, you can modify your game to create new resource packs 
 
MULTIPLAYER ONLINE GAMES 
• Join free massive multiplayer servers and play with thousands of others 
• Multiplayer servers allow you to play with up to 4 players online with a free Xbox Live account 
• Build, battle and explore other realms. With Realms and Realms Plus, you can play with up to 10 friends cross-platform, anytime, anywhere on Realms, your own private server that we host for you 
• With Realms Plus, get instant access to over 150 Marketplace items with new additions each month. Share with friends on your own private Realms server*  
• Connect and play with players across the world, wherever they are, and join in on MMO battles for survival in other worlds 
• Discover gigantic community-run worlds, compete in unique mini-games and socialize in lobbies full of fellow Minecrafters 
 
SUPPORT: https://www.minecraft.net/help 
LEARN MORE: https://www.minecraft.net/

name: Only You Are Here
description:
Only You Are Here — an atmospheric adventure with first-person horror elements. 

Take on the role of a person trapped inside their dream. This place is filled with a mix of memories and nightmares. To get out, you have to open a small door.

Immerse yourself in the game's history, walk through many endings, and discover the key secret.

name: RFS - Real Flight Simulator
description:
EXPERIENCE THE ULTIMATE FLIGHT SIMULATOR ON YOUR MOBILE DEVICE!

Immerse yourself in the captivating world of aviation with RFS - Real Flight Simulator. Our cutting-edge flight simulation technology allows you to experience the thrill of being a pro pilot from your device. Whether you want realistic airplane games or a professional flight simulator, RFS delivers an unparalleled journey.

FLY NOW, ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD!

Learn to take off, land, and complete full flights in a global flight simulation environment. Explore aircraft with 3D live cockpits, visit 30 HD airports, and navigate 500 SD airports. Personalize instruments, use automatic flight plans, and experience the finest detail in this global flight simulator. Master your skills with our pilot tutorials and become a master of flight simulation!
Manual/Tutorial: Real Flight Simulator Wiki
UNLOCK THE FULL REAL FLIGHT SIMULATOR EXPERIENCE
Choose the subscription that fits: monthly, six-month, or yearly. Join virtual aviators and access premium features in the most advanced airplane simulator and flight simulator available on the App Store.

BUCKLE UP AND BECOME A REAL PILOT!

As a pro pilot in our flight simulator, you will enjoy a vast array of features for the ultimate flight simulation:
• 60+ AIRPLANE MODELS: Take command of airplane models with realistic 3D cockpits and authentic lighting. Experience pilot systems and instruments in every flight.
• 1900+ HD AIRPORTS: Land your airplane at 3D airports featuring realistic buildings, vehicles, and authentic ground procedures. This is the most detailed airport simulation in a mobile flight simulator.
• REAL-TIME FLIGHTS & WEATHER: Join 40,000+ real-time flights daily with live air traffic at global hubs. Experience real-time weather that challenges your pilot skills in this realistic flight simulator.
• DETAILED CHECKLISTS: Follow authentic pilot procedures for takeoff and landing to fully immerse yourself in the flight simulation.
• ADVANCED GROUND SYSTEMS: Interact with refueling trucks, passenger vehicles, and follow-me cars upon landing your airplane.
• ADVANCED FLIGHT PLANNING: Customize real-time weather, system failures, and navigation routes. Share flight plans with other pilots for a connected flight simulation community.
• AUTOPILOT & ASSISTED LANDING: Utilize precise autopilot and our Automatic Landing System for long-haul airplane missions.
• REALISTIC SATELLITE SCENERY: Explore the world with high-definition satellite terrain and height maps in stunning 3D. This is global flight simulation at its finest.

ENGAGE IN GLOBAL MULTIPLAYER MODES

• Join hundreds of other pilots and fly together in any part of the world.
• Chat with fellow multiplayer pilots, participate in weekly events, and join Virtual Airlines (VA) to earn Flight Points. RFS is the premier multiplayer flight simulator.

ATC MODE: BECOME AN AIR TRAFFIC CONTROLLER

• ATC GAME MODE: Organize aircraft traffic, give instructions, and guide planes to fly safely.
• Enjoy interactive multi-voice ATC procedures and communications. Experience the dual role of pilot and controller in one simulation.

CREATE AND SHARE YOUR AVIATION PASSION

• CUSTOMIZE YOUR PLANE: Design your own airplane liveries and share them globally.
• DESIGN YOUR AIRPORT: Model your favorite HD airport, and watch other pilots take off from your creation in the flight simulator.
• PLANE SPOTTING: Capture your favorite planes. Experience city lights at night and the ethereal play of light and clouds during sunrise and sunset.
• Join the Real Flight Simulator community, discover new flight routes, and interact with aviation enthusiasts.

REAL-TIME SIMULATION REQUIREMENTS

Internet Connection is required for the full scope of aviation experiences and multiplayer features.

GET READY TO SOAR THE SKIES!

Buckle up and become a Real Pilot in RFS - Real Flight Simulator!

TERMS OF USE: https://www.rortos.com/terms-of-use/
Support: rfs@rortos.com

name: Hitman Sniper
description:
BECOME THE ULTIMATE SILENT ASSASSIN
Step into the shoes of Agent 47 in Hitman: Sniper and discover the most compelling sniper experience on mobile.
 
TACTICAL MISSIONS IN MONTENEGRO
Hone your strategic skills and orchestrate the perfect assassination.
 
ACTION ZOMBIE CHALLENGE IN DEATH VALLEY
Prepare for non-stop action in a true test of your accuracy and speed of execution.
 
MORE THAN 150 MISSIONS AND 11 DIFFERENT CONTRACTS
Improve your strategy for the perfect assassination as you uncover secrets and subterfuges.

17 UNIQUE WEAPONS
Eliminate targets, collect weapon parts and complete blueprints to unlock the most powerful rifles.

COMPETE AGAINST YOUR FRIENDS TO DOMINATE THE LEADERBOARD
Boost your score and climb up the ranks to become the world's finest silent assassin.


Hitman: Sniper is memory intensive. Devices such as iPad 2, iPad Mini, iPhone 4S and iPod Touch 5th Generation will suffer from occasional dips in performance and will not support Everyplay.

name: Border Checkpoint Officer
description:
Border Officer – A Document, Control, and Security Game

Every day is a new day at the border.
Every day, new faces arrive.
Behind every face lies a story, a dream… or a threat.

Border Officer puts you at the center of the toughest decisions as a border officer in a document control and security game.
You must act according to rules, documents, and presidential orders; the cost of a small mistake can be paid by the entire country.

Your Mission
	•	Inspect the documents of incoming characters
	•	Examine stamps and detect forged documents
	•	Scan bags using X-ray screening and find illegal items
	•	Identify and capture wanted criminals
	•	Earn money by making the right decisions

Scanning, Searching, and Security

Not every bag is innocent.
Not every document is valid.

Protect the border using scanning and search systems. Maintain security—but do not reject the innocent.
Sometimes, the right choice is not to follow the rules.
Sometimes, the only right choice is the rules.

Consequences of Your Decisions

Watch the impact of your decisions in the journalist’s broadcast at the end of each day.
Some choices satisfy the public; others push the country toward chaos.

The border is yours. The decision is yours. The consequences are ours.

name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
description:
The Kingdom has fallen. Time has turned back. And the only way to save the future is to defend the past. Welcome to Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis
The legendary tower defense saga by Ironhide Game Studio returns. Travel back to the dawn of Linirea, recruit the heroes who built the kingdom, and stop a young Vez'nan before darkness takes hold.

A PREQUEL, REWRITTEN
Return to the original Kingdom Rush lands at a time when legends were just beginning. Walk through known battlefields and uncover the moment everything went wrong.

15 TOWERS, ENDLESS STRATEGIES
Archers, mages, barracks, artillery, every tower has a specialty, and the real game is the synergy between them. Build your defense, lock the lane, watch the wave break.

12 LEGENDARY HEROES
Take two heroes into each battle and combine their abilities. Familiar Linirean champions return to your side, fighting beside you like the old days, and a few faces you're about to meet for the first time.

9 POWERFUL SPELLS
Equip a loadout of spells and unleash them at the moment that matters, meteor showers, powerful reinforcements, battlefield-wide control. Save them for the bosses. You'll need them!

18 HANDCRAFTED CAMPAIGN STAGES
Cross three landscapes of early Linirea, from the Citadel to the Stormcloud Depths and the far away lands of Arcania. Face 40+ enemies across 5 distinct races, and 6 colossal bosses standing between you and the future.

THE PLOT THICKENS. 
More lore, more callbacks, and the Kingdom Rush humor that made you fall in love with Linirea in the first place.

GAME MODES, ACHIEVEMENTS, AND EASTER EGGS
For the ones who like to 100% everything: 50+ achievements, harder modes if you're feeling brave, and easter eggs we had way too much fun hiding.

OFFLINE, ANYWHERE
Defend the realm on the bus, on a plane, in a tower of your own. No connection required.
Defend the past to change the future. Join the millions of players who have rallied to Linirea since 2011.

name: Dune: Imperium
description:
Immerse yourself in the world of Dune. 

Experience the ultimate blend of strategy and intrigue as you navigate the treacherous landscapes of Arrakis in the award-winning board game Dune: Imperium!

Battle online, locally with AI, or against the formidable House Hagal.

Earn Achievements that showcase your prowess as a leader.

Embark on more than a dozen Challenges that will test your wit and cunning.

Compete for badges in the rotating Skirmish Mode where no two games are the same!

Control the Spice. Control the Universe.

Arrakis. Dune. Desert Planet. Raise your banner above the vast wasteland before you. As the Great Houses of the Landsraad marshal their forces and their spies, whom will you influence, and whom will you betray? A tyrannical Emperor. The secretive Bene Gesserit. The shrewd Spacing Guild. The ferocious Fremen of the Deep Desert. The power of the Imperium can be yours, but war is not the only way to claim it.

Dune: Imperium blends deck-building and worker placement in a deeply thematic new strategy game where the fate of the Empire hangs on your decisions. Will you seek political allies or rely upon military might? Economic strength or subtle intrigues? A council seat… or a sharpened blade? The cards are dealt. The choice is yours. The Imperium awaits.

name: Skul: The Hero Slayer
description:
Skul is a fast-paced action rogue-lite where losing your head is encouraged. 

Featuring 100 playable characters each with their own unique abilities and a ton of items that can create wild synergies, the battles are as electrifying as they are challenging.

The Demon King's Castle in Ruins
The human race attacking the Demon King's castle is nothing new and has happened countless times before.
What makes this time different though, is that the Adventurers decided to join forces with the Imperial Army and the 'Hero of Caerleon' to lead a full onslaught in hopes of wiping out the Demons once and for all. 
They attacked the Demon stronghold with overwhelming numbers and succeeded in its total destruction. All of the demons in the castle were taken prisoner except for one lone skeleton named 'Skul'.

Dark Mirror Mode
Once you're through with the main story, test your skills and limits in the new challenging 'Dark Mirror' mode!

FEATURES
-You’re the last hope of the entire demon race! Play as Skul, a tiny skeleton on a path to slay the pompous heroes and save the demon king from the corrupt army of Carleon.  
-Losing your head never felt so right: try on new skulls to borrow the powers and dashing outfits of their previous owners and create synergies with unique items to defeat your enemies.
-What is dead may never die: you will not rest until you have faced all the challenges of this action-packed rogue-lite platformer.
-Let your hollow eyes feast upon vibrant, cartoony pixel-art 2D animations as you help all sorts of demonic creatures return to their original state.
-From the Mummies of Egypt to the Minotaur of Greece or even an official Dead Cells crossover… Will you spot all the fun easter eggs scattered across the game?

CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
- Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
- Game Center achievements
- Cloud Save – Share your progress between iOS devices
- Compatible with MFi controllers
- iPhone 15 Optimization (including Pro Max)

name: Backpack Battles
description:
[We recommend a total device RAM of 4GB or higher; otherwise, the app may crash due to insufficient memory.]

In Backpack Battles, you fight with your backpack full of items! It matters what you buy, and especially how you place them. The smarter you place your items, the stronger you'll be!

Items come in different shapes, sizes, prices, and rarities. Combine them into even stronger equipment: brew powerful potions, craft legendary weapons, or even hatch a dragon friend!

Face the backpack builds of other real players. See what they came up with, and counter them to win.

Test your limits in Ranked Mode and climb the leaderboard! Or relax in Unranked Mode with low pressure. Both modes have no time limits, so take your time to organize your backpack!

Join our community for discussion and support!

Discord: https://discord.gg/PKPGxFpgFA

Facebook Group: https://www.facebook.com/share/g/1AtWHngD8v/

New Player Guide Video on Youtube：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TFtuXBw4bDM

Contact Us：support.m@indieark.com

name: Mindustry
description:
Mindustry is a factory-building game with tower defense and RTS elements. Create elaborate supply chains to feed ammo into your turrets, produce materials to use for building, and construct units. Command units to capture enemy bases, and expand your production. Defend your core from waves of enemies.

Gameplay Features:
 
- Use production blocks to create a wide variety of advanced materials
- Defend your structures from waves of enemies
- Play with your friends in cross-platform multiplayer co-op games, or challenge them in team-based PvP matches
- Distribute liquids and fight constant challenges, like outbreaks of fire or enemy flier raids
- Get the most out of your production by supplying optional coolant and lubricant
- Produce a wide variety of units for automatic management of your base or assault on enemy bases
- Set up assembly lines to construct armies of mechanized units
- Use your units to square up against fully functional enemy bases


Campaign:

- Conquer the planets Serpulo and Erekir as you advance through 35 hand-made maps and 250+ procedurally generated sectors
- Capture territory and set up factories to produce resources while you play other sectors
- Defend your sectors from periodic invasions
- Coordinate resource distribution between sectors via launch pads
- Research new blocks to fuel progress
- Invite your friends to complete missions together
- 250+ technology blocks to master
- 50+ different types of drones, mechs and ships


Custom Games & Cross-Platform Multiplayer:

- 16+ built in maps for custom games, in addition to two entire campaigns
- Play co-op, PvP or sandbox
- Join a public dedicated server, or invite friends to your own private session
- Customizable game rules: Change block costs, enemy stats, starting items, wave timing and more
- Full functional map editor with scripting support

name: Ace Attorney: Dual Destinies
description:
※NOTICE※
This game does not support devices running iOS 11 (including beta versions) or later. Please be aware of this when changing devices and/or updating your device's iOS as the game may not run properly under an unsupported version of iOS.

※IMPORTANT※
・Please read "Supported iOS and Devices" before purchasing or playing.

In cases where the game unexpectedly crashes:
Please try re-downloading your purchase data (Title Screen -> Purchase Content -> Restore).

If the above steps do not resolve the issue, please contact us at mobilesupport@capcom.com.

== Game Intro ==

There are no "Objections!" to this exciting entry of the Ace Attorney series! Become a lawyer and solve the case. Your client's life is in your hands!
Clear you client in Episode 1, then purchase Episodes 2 through 5 of the main story individually or as a set.

◆Point Your Way to Victory◆
Simply tap the screen to play. The intuitive interface includes useful features such as a backlog for you to re-read testimony and story dialogue.

◆Immersive Investigations◆
Freely explore 3D crime scenes for evidence and speak with witnesses for information that you can use in court.

◆Fast-Paced, Entertaining Trials◆
Dismantle lies and resolve contradictions between witnesses' words and the evidence. Solve the case and save your client from trumped-up charges!

◆Colorful Cast of Characters◆
Join Phoenix Wright and his junior lawyers as they confront an all new cast of interesting, amusing, and sometimes outrageous characters. Fan favorites also make their return under some unexpected and unusual circumstances!

◆Surprising Twists◆
Delight in solving the mysteries and smile at the characters' amusing and often ridiculous shenanigans. The drama and dialogue will keep you laughing, crying, and guessing until the very end!

◆Lighthearted Additional Content◆
Dress the three lawyer protagonists up in costumes and use them in the main game for some unintentionally humorous trials!

In addition, try your hand at the extra Special Episode "Turnabout Reclaimed"! Can you successfully defend a wrongfully accused killer killer whale and bring this aquatic punk pirate show to a happy end?

◆iCloud Support◆
Transfer your save data between multiple iOS devices to play wherever and whenever you want!

※The story in this game is the same as in previous releases.


*When Purchasing Content*
・Episodes 2 through 5 can be purchased separately or together as a pack (Main Story Set). In the event that the content of your purchases overlap, please be aware that we cannot refund you the difference.


*Supported iOS and Devices*
Please check if your iOS and/or device is supported here:

http://www.us.capcommobile.com/pw5-device-compatibility

※We cannot guarantee that this app will work on any iOS or devices not listed on the site above.*Supported iOS and Devices*

https://www.facebook.com/aceattorney

name: PAKO 2
description:
*** RECOMMENDED DEVICE: iPhone SE/iPhone6 OR BETTER ***

PAKO 2 is an arcade driving game where you work as a getaway driver. Pick up your crew from heist spot, escort them to safety in dramatic chase against the cops, repeat and compete in the leaderboards!  Every run gains you money which can be used to buy new rides and locations. Get in, get out, get paid!

FEATURES
- Absolutely NO in-app purchases or ads
- Easy controls!
- Pick up crew members and escort them to safety
- Vast handcrafted levels full of detail
- Drive-by shooting action
- Huge arsenal of cars to buy
- Various guns and special perk items
- Electro soundtrack by DKSTR
- Leaderboards to compete
- Achievements

name: Castlevania: SotN
description:
The iconic game from the beloved Castlevania series finally comes to mobile. This direct port of the classic console action RPG lets you jump, dash and slash your way through Dracula’s vast castle as Alucard while encountering a unique array of enemies and characters along the way.

Rediscover the world of Castlevania with one of its original groundbreaking games and renowned music and graphics.

□Features

Fully compatible with game controllers

New continue feature

Unlock achievements with hard-fought battle milestones

Available in 6 languages: English, Japanese, German, French, Italian, Spanish

name: Grimvalor
description:
Slash your way through the hordes of darkness and defeat King Valor's fearsome guardians in this breathtaking adventure!

"Chaining together a slick series of attacks, dodges, and jumps, is incredibly satisfying." — PocketGamer

"I suspect mobile gaming fans will be playing and replaying this one for years to come." — TouchArcade, 5/5

A malicious power stirs in the forgotten kingdom of Vallaris. Tasked with discovering the fate of its lost king, your quest quickly takes a sinister turn and you are cast into darkness. Surrounded and outnumbered, you must grab your sword, steel your temper and fight your way through a land that does not welcome you. Except for the friendly merchant - he's grateful for your business.

ABOUT THE GAME
Grimvalor is a challenging hack & slash platformer with fast-paced combat in a dark fantasy world. Take control of a lone warrior on a quest to restore a corrupted realm. Embark on a journey through atmospheric landscapes and dungeons in a massive story-driven premium experience.

COMBAT & EXPLORATION
Master skill-based combat, learn enemy patterns and bring them down with all your fury. Explore the shattered lands of Vallaris, find and upgrade equipment and level up your character. Face the legacy of King Valor's madness and prevail!

FEATURES
• Epic boss fights
• Stunning 3D visuals accelerated by Metal graphics
• Accurate and customizable touch controls
• Full support for MFi game controllers
• Use iCloud to keep your saves in sync between devices.
• Play offline - perfect for commute.
• No ads or in-app purchases

name: Slay the Spire
description:
We fused card games and roguelikes together to make the best single player deckbuilder we could. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics of immense power, and Slay the Spire!

Features:

- Dynamic Deck Building: Choose your cards wisely! Discover hundreds of cards to add to your deck with each attempt at climbing the Spire. Select cards that work together to efficiently dispatch foes and reach the top
- An Ever-changing Spire: Whenever you embark on a journey up the Spire, the layout differs each time. Choose a risky or safe path, face different enemies, choose different cards, discover different relics, and even fight different bosses!
- Powerful Relics to Discover: Powerful items known as relics can be found throughout the Spire. The effects of these relics can greatly enhance your deck through powerful interactions. But beware, obtaining a relic may cost you more than just gold…

name: MuseDash
description:
"Hitting while listening to music."
"Is that the call from another world?"
[Game Starts Now—!!]

Lovely girls
or rhythmic music?
If there’s a place for you to have them both…
It must be the paradise of parkour & rhythm game  — Muse Dash!!

Huh?! Not your forte? It doesn’t matter!
Who says you must have a strong sense of rhythm to win?
Avoid is also a valid option (?)
As long as you have 100% of passion, courage, and… love for lovely girls~
Rhythm and fight won’t be an issue

[Gameplay]
Dance to the music and beat enemies in the air and on the ground. Also, watch out for the obstacles!!
What an easy, beginner-friendly rhythm game

[Media Review]
可愛らしいビジュアルのキャラクターが躍動する、新感覚の2Dアクションスタイルのリズムゲーム ——IGN Japan

Explore the most obscure levels of Banban’s Kindergarten. Survive the new deceives and mysteries that await you. Uncover the truth behind the place, and find the whereabouts of your missing child…

Your friends are either dead or turned against you. From now on, you only meet new enemies who will make sure you never feel alone! In Banban’s Kindergarten, there are enemies to be made in every corner...

name: Hmmsim Legacy
description:
Hmmsim 2 has been reborn with Unreal Engine.
With dynamic sky, shadows, and headlight effects, it delivers more realistic scenery and atmosphere.

Hmmsim Legacy includes built-in routes based on Seoul Subway Lines 2 and 7, recreated with top-quality graphics.
Experience subway operations firsthand.

In addition, Hmmsim Legacy supports BVE Trainsim Add-Ons.
You can enjoy the same BVE routes you played on PC directly on mobile devices.
Expand your experience endlessly with Add-Ons tailored to your preferences.

name: Mob Control
description:
Lead, Multiply, and Conquer! Mob Control delivers thrilling tower defense action where you grow your mob, deploy powerful Champions, and crush enemy bases. Unlock collectible cards, conquer exciting modes, and climb the Champions League. Rise to tower defense supremacy!

Unleash Your Inner Commander in Mob Control: The Ultimate Tower Defense Clash!

Defend, Conquer, and Rise to Victory in this Epic Tower Defense Showdown!

Ready to become the ultimate tower defense champion? Test your skills, wit, and tactical prowess!

ODDLY SATISFYING GAMEPLAY: CREATE, GROW, AND LEAD!
- Experience the strangely satisfying thrill of watching your mob multiply as you aim and shoot at the gates. Witness your army grow to massive proportions!
- Strategically deploy your mighty Champions to break through enemy mobs and reach their bases. Choose the best combo for victory!
- Explore intriguing level elements like speed boosts, multipliers, moving gates, and more.

BECOME AN IMMORTAL PLAYER: RISE THROUGH THE RANKS!

Earn Championship Stars by winning battles, fortifying your bases, and dominating tournaments. Climb the prestigious Champions League using your Championship Stars and join the elite few who have conquered this tower defense realm.

FORTIFY YOUR BASE: SHIELD YOUR DOMINION!

Secure your base from enemy raids by winning battles and earning valuable shields. Protect your resources and maintain your tower defense dominance.

UNLOCK AND UPGRADE CARDS: COLLECT, EVOLVE, AND DOMINATE!

Win battles to unlock booster packs of varying rarities and enhance your card collection. Unlock all the Cannons, Mobs and Champions in the armory and discover their amazing evolutions as you level them up.

DIVERSE GAME MODES: CHALLENGE AND CONQUER!
- Base Invasion: Raid enemy strongholds, pilfer coins, and claim bricks from rival players.
- Revenge and Counter-Attack: Turn the tables on attackers and seek retribution against those who challenge your might.
- Boss Levels: Test your mettle in unique level layouts, earning extra bonuses as you conquer the toughest adversaries.

SEASON PASS: A CONSTANT STREAM OF FRESH CONTENT!

Dive into ever-evolving content with our monthly Season Pass. Complete quests, advance tiers, and unlock new heroes, Cannons and skins.

ALWAYS IMPROVING: JOIN THE EVOLUTION!

Our dedicated team delivers fresh mechanics and content every month. Share your ideas via Settings > Discord and contribute to the evolution of Mob Control.

A PREMIUM EXPERIENCE: YOUR CHOICE TO PLAY AD-FREE!

Mob Control is free to download and utilises ads to support ongoing development. Opt for the Premium Pass or a permanent no-ads package to enjoy uninterrupted tower defense action. Skip'Its speed up your progress and give you extra rewards without watching ads.

Join the tower defense clash! Rally your army, collect powerful cards, and become the champion you were born to be.

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
- This app may offer monthly subscriptions.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You can cancel your subscription at any time, but you will not get a refund for any remaining period of a subscription.

Support: Your Satisfaction Matters! Connect with us in-game via Settings > Help and Support whenever you need assistance.

Your privacy is crucial to us. Review our comprehensive privacy policy at https://www.voodoo.io/privacy

TERMS OF SERVICE: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Block Out! - Color Sort Puzzle
description:
Get ready for Block Out!, a block puzzle game where every level feels alive. Slide colorful blocks, match them with their targets while experiencing the unique twist of moving elevators and block generators. Each puzzle feels fresh with ever-changing layouts. Plan your moves, think quickly, and enjoy the satisfaction of perfect clears as you progress through a colorful and evolving puzzle adventure. Ludo King is the modern version of the royal game of Parchisi, a game played between Indian kings and queens in ancient times. Roll the dice to play and move your tokens to reach the center of the board. Beat the other players to become the Ludo King. Play this dice game Ludo King. Best casual game in board games.

Ludo has different names in different regions and countries like Fia, Fia-spel (Fia the game), Le Jeu de Dada (The Game of Dada), Non t'arrabbiare, Fia med knuff (Fia with push), Cờ cá ngựa, Uckers, Griniaris, Petits Chevaux (Little Horses), Ki nevet a végén, برسي (Barjis/Barjees). People also misspell Ludo as Loodo, Lido, Lado, Ledo, Leedo, Laado, or Lodo. 

Ludo's versions are Trouble, Sorry, Aeroplane chess, Chopat, Chaupur, Pachisi or Parcheesi.

Features of Ludo King:
•	No internet connection required! Play against the computer.
•	Play with your family and friends through Local and Online Multiplayer.
•	Play with 2 to 6 Players in Local Multiplayer Mode.
•	Invite and challenge your Facebook Friends in a Private Game Room and beat them to become Ludo King.
•	Play with world players and make them your buddies.
•	Private Chat with your Facebook friends & Buddies.
•	Play Snake and Ladders on 7 different gameboards.
•	Simple rules which can be followed by players of all ages.

Play the game of Kings with your family and friends. While the gameplay might seem simple at first, the game is immensely enjoyable and challenging. It’s fun for the whole family; You’ll be playing this one for hours. Try to beat your opponents and compete for the highest scores on the leaderboards.

How to play Ludo King:
The objective of the game is pretty straightforward; each player gets 4 tokens, these tokens must make a full turn of the board and then make it to the finish line. Whoever gets all four tokens to the end first is the winner. However, each move can only be made based on the number decided by casting a six-sided die, and each token can only move out of their home by casting a six. Additionally, the competition factor of the games is upped by the fact that while moving if another player’s token lands on the same square as your token, then your token will automatically be sent back home and you’ll need to roll a six again.

Another nostalgic game similar in structure is Snakes and Ladders. Ludo King now incorporates this classic game as a whole new level. The objective of the game is simple: you start on 1 and you have to be the first one to make it to 100. However, you can only move the same number of tiles as the number you roll on a die. As the name suggests, the board is also littered with snakes and ladders. If you land on the same tile as the beginning of a ladder, then you can take the ladder as a shortcut and move on up. But if you land on the mouth of a snake, then down you go to its tail. A game of ups and down, Snakes and Ladders has been a favorite for generations; and now you can play it too, with Ludo King.

name: Food Hunt: Pixel Puzzle
description:
Every level is a pixel art masterpiece. Your ants will devour it - one color at a time.

Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. Sort your ants by color, send them in, and watch them eat the picture clean - block by block, until the board is empty and the level is cleared.

HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.

But choose your order carefully:

- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!

THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.

Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.

You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.

FEATURES
-  200+ color sort puzzle levels -  new images, new challenges
-  Cute ants with ASMR-quality chomping animations
-  Simple one-tap controls - play with one hand
-  No timer, no pressure - relax at your own pace
- Levels designed to surprise - no two boards look the same
- 2× speed mode for snappier ant action

EASY TO LEARN. HARD TO STOP.
Early levels are breezy. Later levels pack in more colors, tighter slots, and bigger images that demand real planning.

Which color do you clear first? When do you free a slot before it jams? Every tap matters.

A true logic brain teaser - wrapped in pixel art you'll actually enjoy destroying.

WHY YOU CHOOSE FOOD HUNT?
Most color sort games show you an empty grid and ask you to fill it. Food Hunt flips it - every board starts full, alive with pixel art, and your only goal is to wipe it clean.
Same satisfying sort. A completely different feeling. 

Download Food Hunt - the color sort puzzle where the art is the game.

name: Arrow Puzzle - Arrows Game
description:
Arrow Puzzle is a relaxing logic game that turns simple taps into a rewarding challenge. Your goal is straightforward: find a free path, tap arrows in the right order, and enjoy as the maze slowly turns into a clear, empty board. Follow the arrows to escape the puzzle and find a soothing flow that keeps your mind engaged and relaxed.

Looking for a gentle workout for your brain without any pressure attached? This comforting arrow game lets you tap away the stress, gives you a focused break from the noise, and helps you train your logic and spatial thinking as you build a calming daily ritual. Each cleared board in the arrow game is a small mental reset—a satisfying win for your mind.

How to Play Arrow Puzzle:

- In this tap away puzzle game, your goal is to clear the grid—a maze of arrows all pointing in different directions.
- Escape the arrow puzzle grid by finding a free path. An arrow moves only when its way ahead is clear and no other arrows are blocking its path. Take a moment to think first.
- Tap arrows away one by one to help them leave the grid and open up more space for the others.
- Avoid blocked arrows. If you tap an arrow whose path is blocked, you lose a life. Lives are limited on each level, but you can always rethink your plan and try again at your own pace.
- If you get stuck, use helpful hints to highlight an arrow that can safely escape the maze.
- Plan the order of your taps, help every arrow escape, and enjoy the moment when the last arrow leaves and everything falls into place.

Why You'll Love Arrow Puzzle:

• A minimalist arrow game with simple rules and deep strategy—easy to start, satisfying to master.
• Hundreds of handcrafted tap away style puzzles that grow in challenge as you play.
• Daily Challenges—play every day, complete monthly challenges, and collect unique trophies.
• Helpful hints when you need a small nudge to release an arrow and keep the flow going.
• No timer, no pressure—a relaxing escape and a true delight for your mind.
• Clean, calming visuals and smooth animations that keep the focus on puzzle-solving in this tap game.

Play Arrow Puzzle, clear the grid of arrows, and enjoy a rare balance of sharp focus and deep relaxation.

description:

Jam Bus: Sandfall brings a fresh twist to bus jam, color puzzle, and traffic escape gameplay.
Colorful sand is stacked in layers, and every bus has its own color and direction. Tap the right bus, collect the matching sand, and clear the board step by step. Sounds simple at first, but every move can change the whole puzzle.

How to play
• Tap a bus to move it along its route
 • Match each bus with the same color sand
 • Clear lower sand layers to unlock the ones above
 • Avoid traffic crashes when paths cross
 • Solve each level with smart sequencing
Why you’ll enjoy Jam Bus: Sandfall
• Easy tap controls
 • Relaxing color-matching gameplay
 • Clever bus parking jam puzzles
 • Satisfying sand-clearing effects
 • Increasingly tricky routes and layers
 • Clean visuals and smooth puzzle flow
 • Great for quick breaks and brain training
Every level is a small logic challenge. A bus may look ready to move, but its route might block another vehicle. A color may be visible, but the sand below it must be cleared first. Think ahead, follow the arrows, and find the perfect order to clear the whole sandfall.
If you enjoy bus games, parking jam puzzles, color sort games, traffic escape challenges, or relaxing logic games, Jam Bus: Sandfall gives you a colorful new puzzle to solve.
Start with one bus, clear one color, and let the sand fall into place.

name: Kulfi: Games for Couples
description:
You talk to them every day. And still, by 10pm, you're both just trading reels and typing "kya kar rahe ho" for the ninth time. You're not fighting. You're not bored of each other. You're just out of things to do.

Nobody warns you about this part of loving someone in India. A lot of us don't share a city, forget a room. The whole relationship lives inside a phone. Two grey ticks, a few voice notes, one call before bed. So much love stuck inside a very small screen.

Three of us built Kulfi, and we were all in the same spot. Long-term partners we love, who make our day. But once the day's been talked through, it all starts to repeat. What we missed wasn't the conversation, it was their presence. We didn't want to sit alone at night scrolling Instagram. We wanted to be in the same room as them, even when we couldn't. Half our video calls were just silence, nothing left to say. And it wasn't only us. Almost everyone we knew was in the same quiet.

Here's the only promise we care about: no couple on Kulfi should have a boring conversation again. We take that dead late-night chat and turn it into banter, teasing, a bit of fighting, and a lot of "wait, that's not fair."

Kulfi doesn't work like anything you've played. The games run across two phones, yours and theirs, at once. Some split the controls between you, so it's one game, one boat, each holding one half. Mess up your side and you both go down together.

Here's the part we love most. It's made for when you're already on a call. Put Kulfi on while you're on a video or audio call at night, and play straight through it. You're on the call anyway. This is what you do during it.

One house rule. No singles allowed. You invite your partner, send them a code, they punch it in, and you're paired. Till then, the games stay locked. Sounds a bit harsh, but that's the point. Kulfi is a two-person club, and if you're inside it, you've already got the one thing it asks for.

And you won't run dry. We add fresh games every single week. That's a founder promise, not a marketing line. We're trying to keep our own partners entertained, so trust me, the new stuff keeps coming.

Here's some of what's inside:

Pirate Escape
One boat, two captains. One wrong tap and you're both underwater. Stay in sync, or sink.

Snatch the Fries
The plate's between you and there was never enough. Grab fast. Love is conditional now.

Yeet the Spider
Aim, hold your nerve, fling it before the music stops. Don't ask, just throw.

Basketball Rivalry
Twenty seconds on the clock, zero mercy. Outscore them, or hear about it all night.

Four in a Row
Looks innocent. Ends relationships. Drop your coin, block theirs, act like you planned it.

Never Have I Ever
The cards ask, you answer honestly. Some answers you'll wish you could take back.

Who's More Likely To
You each lock in a guess. Then the reveal. Then the argument that lasts an hour.

Pillow Talk
The soft one. A quiet prompt, a real answer, the kind of 2am talk you don't get over text.


Underneath all of it, there's Roadtrip. The more you play, the more miles you and your partner rack up, and your little car moves further across the map. You unlock new cities, crack clues for what's next, and slowly take the road trip you keep saying you'll go on someday. Every other Kulfi couple is on that road too. You can't always meet. You can still go somewhere together.
One honest thing. Nearly every app you live on, Instagram, Snapchat, WhatsApp, was built somewhere else. India has over 200 million couples, and Kulfi is the couples app built in India, for India. We want it in the hands of every couple in the country.

So that's our ask. We built this to solve our own problem and sweated every detail. Download it, play it, and tell us honestly what's broken and what you loved. And please, spread the word. We're a young company, every download counts, and the fastest way Kulfi reaches the couple who needs it is you.

See you on the road,
The founders of Kulfi

name: Due - Reminders & Timers
description:
Due remembers all the things that you need so you don't have to.

It reminds you again and again until you act, so it’s impossible to forget anything.

And it's lightning-fast to set and postpone reminders, all thanks to a clever time picker and natural date parsing.


KEY FEATURES

1. Persistent & Effective
Auto Snooze* keeps nudging you about a missed reminder until you mark it done or reschedule it. Choose between every 1, 5, 10, 15, 30 and 60 minutes.

2. Impossible to Miss
Some reminders can't wait. Use Critical Alerts to get through silent mode and Focus. Or use Prominent Alerts†, which ring like an alarm until you act.

3. Fast to Set, Fast to Postpone
Keep the times you use most a tap away. Twelve Quick Access Times—all fully customizable—make setting or postponing reminders a piece of cake.

4. Just Type or Say It
Type or say “Dentist 3p Thu” or “Meeting in 1h 20m”. Due spots the date, and one tap sets it.

5. Powerful Recurring Reminders
From simple daily reminders to the every-3rd-Wednesday-of-the-month kind, Due keeps up with your routine.

6. Countdown Timers
Not every reminder happens at a time of day. Some happen when the laundry cycle is done. That's what timers are for: precise to the second, with Auto Snooze too. Or just say “Hey Siri, start Laundry timer in Due”.

7. On Your Apple Watch
Wear an Apple Watch? Due comes with you. Mark reminders done, snooze them, add new ones, start and stop timers—all from your wrist. It's a companion to Due on iPhone, so keep your iPhone nearby.

8. Widgets, Control Center & Shortcuts
See what's coming up on your Home Screen and Lock Screen. Start timers and add reminders from Control Center, and automate the rest with Shortcuts.

9. Everywhere You Are
Your reminders and timers on your iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac‡, all kept in sync with iCloud or Dropbox.

10. No Account, Completely Private
There's no account to sign up for. We don't store, and we can't access, your reminders and timers. And you don't need internet to receive reminders.

11. Accessible to Everyone
Due follows the text size you set on your device, on every screen, and offers full VoiceOver support. It's also localized in 17 languages.


* By default, auto snooze repeats 5 times, and can be configured to repeat up to 10 times. Due can auto snooze any overdue items indefinitely when you launch Due or act on any of its notifications.
† Prominent Alerts require iOS 26 or later.
‡ Sync on Mac requires Due for Mac (sold separately).


WHAT'S THAT IN-APP PURCHASE ABOUT?

When you purchase Due today, you will have access to every feature in the app today—no further purchase required.

You will also get every new feature released within a year of your purchase.

The optional Due Upgrade Pass subscription gives you access to new features released after that first year.

And here's the deal: Every feature that you have unlocked will remain available to you, forever—even if you stop subscribing.

Even without a subscription, you'll always receive bug-fix and compatibility updates for free. These updates add support for the latest iPhones, iPads and Apple Watches, and keep Due working well on the latest versions of iOS, iPadOS and watchOS.

Due has a pretty good track record with that.

To illustrate: If you bought Due back in 2010 for your iPhone 3G running iOS 4, that very same app in 2026 is now optimized for iPhone 18 Pro Max running iOS 27. It even works on devices that didn't exist back then, such as the iPad Pro and the Apple Watch.

TERMS & PRIVACY POLICY

Our terms of use and privacy policy are available here: https://www.dueapp.com/terms.html


COMPATIBILITY

Due requires an iPhone or iPad running iOS 18 or later. The Apple Watch app requires watchOS 10 or later, and your paired iPhone nearby.

description:

ALL YOUR MUSIC, ONE WHEEL

Server streams direct-play whenever possible, so lossless stays lossless. Shuffle with no unwanted repeats, plus Shuffle Albums for full records. Albums keep playing like the classics did: the last track flows into the next album. Plus star ratings and automatic playlists.

YOUR LIBRARY, YOUR RULES
One-time purchase. No subscriptions required for your own music, no in-app purchases, no account, no advertising, no tracking, no personal data collection. Your library stays on your device, and your own files play 100% offline. Pay once and keep it forever. You choose the music — NostalgicPod simply gives you a better way to enjoy it.

MORE THAN A PLAYER

Your music. Your device. Press play.

name: Internet Speed Limiter
description:
Limit your internet speed using this simple app.

* It's simple to use and activate in one click. You can also add and manage different speed profiles and switch between them seamlessly.

* Internet Speed Limiter lets you throttle the bandwidth of your Apple Device. Finely control download and upload speed on your device. 

* It works by creating a local VPN that intelligently throttles all your internet traffic right on the device. Because the VPN is created and runs entirely locally, no data is ever sent to any third-party server. Your connection stays completely private. 100% safe and 100% under your control.

* Real Time Internet Usage
Analyse what service / IP is using more data with live history of entire Internet Traffic going through your device.  Find out what are hidden services that use data in background. 

* Overrides - Per app, per website, and per IP limits
Identify domains / services / IP address used by certain App from real time history and group them together into one app. Then put override on that entire app for limiting its upload or download speed. 

* Shortcuts, Control Centre and Automations
Start or stop a speed profile from Control Centre, or start, stop, and switch profiles using the Shortcuts app. Trigger automatically by location (office, home, port, vessel), by time of day, or by any other Shortcut automation you already use. No need to open the app every time the network or other conditions should change. Use speed limiter smartly with complex shortcuts and automations to save even more data seamlessly.
There is also a shortcut to trigger Live Activity that shows real time speed usage.

* Live Activity on Dynamic Island and Lock Screen
Live Activity puts your real-time download and upload speed on Dynamic Island and the Lock Screen.
iOS has no built-in place that shows current internet speed while you use other apps. Only this app can pin that live rate on the Island and the lock screen, so you see usage without unlocking or opening Settings.
Glance once, know how fast the phone is running, and catch a spike before it burns through your data.

* Use Cases
Developers can use it to simulate how real word speeds affect their apps, websites and services for iOS. They can also add latency to packets to simulate users.
Seafarers, Mariners and other users for whom data is expensive and limited. 

Set a download and upload cap so streaming apps, social apps, and background updates uses less data instead of burning a prepaid SIM, roaming pack, shared hotspot, or shipboard allotment. For seafarers, mariners and anyone else on metered connection, crew WiFi, or a tight monthly plan - this limiter keeps email, messaging, and essential tools usable while one video stream no longer finishes the quota.

Useful for Developers who want to Simulate and test their app or service under real speeds on iPhone or iPad itself without Mac, proxy or Network Link Conditioner. Choose any Data Speed, add latency and watch live throughput while every service on the device runs through that pipe. It’s useful for testing application behaviour under limited throughput, and getting a clearer picture of per-device or per-app bandwidth use.

Developers and QA can troubleshoot timeouts, broken loaders, and poor offline behaviour on a physical iPhone, then turn the limiter off in one tap.

name: HTTPS Only for Safari
description:
• Available on all your devices, on iOS, iPad and macOS •

When visiting a website, a person usually leaves a lot of information about himself. And without any measures on the part of the site owner, these personal data may be stolen. If you do not want something of the sort to happen, consider accessing all sites via the HTTPS technology.

HTTPS Only is a Safari extension that protects your browsing activity by automatically enabling the HTTPS protocol on all websites that you visit. By loading the HTTPS version of websites into your browser, all your traffic will be encrypted, reliable and surveillance free.

Although major websites already encrypt the traffic by using HTTPS, it’s not guaranteed that you use this technology - sometimes is not active by default or some embedded assets are loaded through the default and unencrypted HTTP connections. Also, clicking links can redirect you to the insecure versions of sites. Actually more than 75% of websites out there still rely on unencrypted HTTP communications.

The HTTPS Only extension will fix these problems by rewriting all your requests from HTTP to HTTPS. It will also make sure that the assets from the visited websites (images, styles, scripts or ads) are transferred via the safe HTTPS and no one can steal your cookies, passwords, sessions or private data.

• What is the HTTPS protocol and why should you care? •
Did you know that browsing the web in a coffee shop, airport or hotel with free internet access can be dangerous? Even your own home or company internet connection is not safe. This is because the common HTTP web traffic can be intercepted in clear text, inspected and even modified by anyone.
HTTPS has significantly more secure since this protocol will encrypt your communications.

• The benefits of the HTTPS protocol and why should you use it? •
- Faster page loading: data sent over HTTPS loads faster since the new HTTP/2 protocol is available in Safari only on encrypted communications
- Confidentiality: no one can read your content, passwords or messages
- Integrity: your traffic cannot be modified - for example, no key-loggers can be injected
- Authentication: your site cannot be routed to a clone without you knowing it

• Is this a VPN service? •
No, this extension is not a VPN service, but is very efficient and safe as a VPN. This extension will make sure you are using only HTTPS in your surfing and the usage of HTTPS will make your traffic encrypted, reliable and surveillance free. Also, HTTPS is much faster than a VPN and can protect you even if the VPN is logging your activity.

• Support •
We read your support emails every day, day by day.
Write with confidence any question, feedback or complaint and you will receive an answer in a very short period of time.

name: Sun Seeker - Tracker & Compass
description:
Sun Seeker is a comprehensive solar tracking & compass app. It shows the sun’s hourly direction intervals, its equinoxes, winter & summer solstice paths, sunrise & sunset times, twilight times, shadowed periods, UV Index, solar irradiance, golden and blue hours, eclipses & more. The app allows you to add sun-event notifications & has a widget and watch app showing the day’s solar data & position on an arc. The 3D View shows the solar direction for each sunlight hour. Sun Seeker has both a flat compass view & a 3D Augmented Reality (AR) view to show the solar position & path.

The app is useful for - 

▶ Photographers- to plan shoots according to the golden hour or blue hour & optimal sunlight conditions, sunrise & sunset times & directions.
▶ Cinematographers- enables you to find the solar exposure, directions, shadow, sunrise & sunset times for any location.
▶ Real Estate Buyers- can use the app before buying a property to check the sun's path & to find the solar exposure of properties.
▶ Drivers - Sun Seeker lets you track the sun path & movement during the days & helps drivers know the sun position to find how long the car will remain in the shade at any given parking spot.
▶ Campers & Picnickers- for anyone planning a day out, this app will help in finding where to camp, sit or pitch an umbrella depending on the sunlight & sun direction. 
▶ Gardeners- Sun Seeker can also help with finding optimal planting locations & seasonal sunlight hours as a sunrise calendar
▶ Architects & Surveyors- for visualising the spatial variability of the solar angle throughout the year & using the compass app as a sun surveyor & calendar to determine the sunlight directions.
 
Main Features
* Sun Seeker is a sun locator which uses GPS, magnetometer & gyroscope to find the correct solar position & sun path for your current location.
* Flat compass view shows current solar position, diurnal solar angle & elevation (separated into day & night segments), sun shadow length ratio, atmospheric path thickness.
* 3D augmented reality (AR) camera overlay view shows the sun's current position, and it's path with hour points marked. You can scroll through time to preview changes throughout the year or day, and an optional pointer to guide you towards the current location of the sun & help you find the sun's direction. 
* Map view shows solar direction arrows, sun path & elevations for each hour of the day.
* Choose any date to view sun position & path on that day. You can view sunset & sunrise times for each day as well.
* Choose any location on earth (includes 40,000+ cities or custom locations available offline, as well as a comprehensive online map search capability).
* Get additional details including sunrise, sunset & culmination times, maximum elevation, civil, nautical & astronomical twilight periods of the sun.
* Optional device notifications for all manner of sun-related periods & events, such as golden hour or blue hour, various twilight periods, or sun crossing a given compass heading or elevation.

The Sun Seeker app has been featured in numerous high-profile blogs, websites & publications, including Wall Street Journal, Washington Post, Sydney Morning Herald etc. "Truly amazing", "Incredible", "Brilliant - the most genuinely useful application of augmented reality - ever!"

Check out our YouTube video here: https://bit.ly/2Rf0CkO
Simply search YouTube for "Sun Seeker app" to find many videos, websites & blogs created by our enthusiastic users

FAQs
* See https://bit.ly/2FIPJq2 - also easily accessible from the app's info screen

Note
* The compass accuracy depends on having an undistorted magnetic field around your device. If you use it close to metallic objects or electrical equipment, directional accuracy may be impaired. The device’s compass accuracy can be optimised by calibrating it prior to use. See app’s FAQs for more help.

PC View Mode changes the actual viewport width — giving you a real desktop layout.

· Built-in: Changes User-Agent only → Responsive sites stay in mobile layout
· PC View Mode: Changes viewport width → True desktop layout displayed

FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe.

SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.

UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it. 

SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange. 

100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published. 

POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.

RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. 

FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs.

SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.

PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.

For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats. Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices. This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files. Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient.

We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.

name: UMANG
description:
UMANG (Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance) is envisaged to make e-governance 'mobile first'. It is developed by Indian Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) and National e-Governance Division (NeGD).
                                                                                                     
It is an evolving platform designed for citizens of India to offer them access to the pan-India e-Gov services from the Central, State, Local Bodies, and Agencies of government on app, web, SMS, and IVR channels.
 
Key Features:
- Unified Platform: It brings together all government departments and their services on a single platform to provide better and easier services to citizens.
- Mobile First Strategy: It aligns all government services with the mobile first strategy to leverage mobile adoption trends.    
- Integration with Digital India Services: It provides seamless integration with other Digital India Services like Aadhaar, DigiLocker, and PayGov. Any new such service will automatically be integrated with the platform.
- Uniform Experience: It is designed to enable citizens to discover, download, access, and use all government services easily.
- Secure and Scalable: It supports Aadhaar-based and other authentication mechanisms for service access. The sensitive profile data is saved in an encrypted format and no one can view this information.               
 
Key Services:
UMANG provides easy access to a plethora of Indian government services ranging from – Healthcare, Finance, Education, Housing, Energy, Agriculture, Transport to even Utility and Employment and Skills.
 
Key Benefits for Citizens:
- Single-Point Ubiquitous Access: All government services are available for citizens on a unified platform for easy access through multiple online and offline channels (SMS, email, app, and web).      
- More for Less: Only a single mobile app needs to be installed instead of each app of each department.
- Convenience: Citizens do not even need to install or update the app again to avail government services if more services are added to the platform.
- Saving of Time and Money: Citizens can anytime and anywhere avail these services through their mobile phones, desktops, and laptops without any need for visiting the department office and standing in queues.
- Uniform Experience: All the government services including payment-based transactions provide secure and uniform experience.

name: RailOne
description:
RailOne: Your All-in-One App by Indian Railways
RailOne is a comprehensive app developed by Indian Railways, designed to consolidate all public-facing services into a single, user-friendly platform. By integrating multiple functionalities into one app, RailOne simplifies the travel experience with a seamless single sign-on (SSO) system. Whether you’re planning a trip, booking tickets, or seeking additional services during your journey, RailOne is your ultimate travel companion. 

Key Features:
Plan and Book Tickets: Effortlessly plan journeys, search for trains, and book reserved or unreserved tickets through the app. This consolidation reduces the need for multiple platforms, streamlining the booking process.
- My- Bookings: This functionality enables the users to check the details and history information of both booked and canceled tickets (unreserved and reserved) at the same platform. User interface presents the filtering  functionality as per user’s preference based on duration and transaction type.
-You: This functionality enables users to view profile details and edit if needed. Also shows status of profile completion. Gives access for changing password, enabling/disabling biometric. Users can also verify email, edit their name (can be done only once) and delete account. These options are available under My Account Tab. User can also Add money to his R-wallet.
Real-time Train Tracking: Track your train in real-time with live updates on delays, expected arrival times, and other critical information, keeping you informed and helping you adjust your plans.

Coach Position Finder: Locate your coach’s position on the platform easily, making the boarding process smoother and more convenient.

Order Food on the Go: Place food orders from partner vendors while on board, ensuring fresh and timely meals during your journey.

Rail Madad: Use the Rail Madad feature to raise and track complaints or feedback directly with Indian Railways for quick resolution.

Refund Requests: Simplify the process of requesting refunds for canceled or missed journeys through the app.

Multilingual Support: Access the app in multiple languages, catering to India’s diverse population and enhancing accessibility.

R-Wallet Integration: Utilize R-Wallet, a digital wallet integrated into the app, for secure and convenient payments for various services.

The app is developed by CRIS (Centre for Railway Information Systems), an organization under the Ministry of Railways. CRIS combines skilled IT professionals with experienced railway personnel to design, develop, and maintain critical software systems for Indian Railways. Key systems developed by CRIS include:

Reserved Ticketing System: Efficiently manages millions of long-distance seat bookings.
Unreserved Ticketing System: Facilitates easy ticketing for short-distance journeys.
Train Search and Tracking: Offers real-time train search and tracking features.
Coach Position Finder: Enhances the boarding process by helping passengers find their coach.
Rail Madad: Manages grievances and feedback effectively.
Food Ordering System: Allows passengers to order food from partner vendors.
Refund Systems: Processes refunds smoothly for booking errors and cancellations.
CRIS continues to lead in innovation, developing integrated solutions that make travel more efficient. The partnership between CRIS and Indian Railways has been instrumental in modernizing railway infrastructure and enhancing passenger services through advanced technology. RailOne embodies this digital evolution, making train travel smarter, more comfortable, and more accessible. With ongoing developments in RailOne and CRIS’s IT systems, Indian Railways aims to provide an exceptional travel experience, leveraging technology to simplify every aspect of your journey.

Zoom Workplace brings video meetings, chat, phone, appointment scheduler, email, and collaborative documents together in a single app. With Zoom AI built in to help you take notes, summarize, write, and organize, you can get more done without the busy work.*

Power Your Work with AI 
• Capture every conversation: Whether you're hosting or joining, My Notes can automatically take notes during your Zoom Meetings and in-person conversations, so you can stay focused instead of scribbling.
• Catch up instantly: Get automatic meeting summaries and next steps sent to you after the call, so you don’t have to take notes again.
• Ask questions live: Missed something? Ask AI Companion questions like "What did I miss?" or "Was my name mentioned?" during a meeting without interrupting.
• Draft in seconds: Let AI embedded in Zoom Workplace compose emails, chat responses, and whiteboard ideas for you with a simple prompt.

Seamless Communication
• Connect with anyone: Host or join meetings with crystal-clear video and audio, and work like you're side-by-side with immersive views.
• Stay in sync: Use Zoom Chat to message individuals or groups, organize conversations with channels, and share files instantly.
• Make business calls: Handle calls with Zoom Phone, a robust VoIP solution.*
• Update asynchronously: Record and share Clips—short video messages and screen recordings—to provide updates that your team can watch on their own time.

Next-Gen Collaboration
• Create together: Draft, edit, and collaborate on Docs in real-time, right inside your meetings.
• Brainstorm freely: Use Whiteboard to map out ideas with sticky notes and shapes—or ask AI Companion to generate a mind map for you instantly.
• Share information: Co-edit files and wikis that live right next to your team’s video interface so you never lose context.

Productivity & Organization
• Manage your day: Bring your email and calendar into one unified view to schedule meetings and check messages without switching apps.
• Stop the scheduling ping-pong: Use Zoom Scheduler to share your availability and let others book time slots that work for everyone.*
• Use Zoom AI agentic skills to answer questions like “summarize today's meetings” to instantly connect the dots across your workflows.

Zoom Workplace Pro
Unlock the full experience with a paid subscription:
• Core AI features embedded across Zoom Workplace
• Host unlimited meetings up to 30 hours each.
• Cloud recording storage to save and share your meetings.
• Grant co-hosting and scheduling permissions to other users.

20 services across home help. Pick one, or stack a few into a single visit so one Pro handles everything in one trip.

One-off help: Pre-Party Express Clean for a sharp tidy before guests, After-Party Express Clean for the morning after, and Packing or Unpacking when you're moving in or out.

How it works

Pick the services you need. Pick a time. Choose Instant for a Pro within 15 minutes, Scheduled for any future slot, or Recurring for daily, weekly, or a custom cadence. Pause, reschedule, or cancel any visit before it starts, right from the app.

Why Pronto instead of hiring directly

Every Pronto Pro is trained and background-verified. Pricing is transparent and shown live in the app for your address: per task or per hourly bundle, no per-bedroom multipliers, no advance deposits, no hidden fees. If a Pro can't make it, the system reassigns automatically so you're not left without help.

Where Pronto is live

11 cities across India: Bangalore, Delhi, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, Gurgaon, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Noida, Pune, and Thane. Open the app, enter your address, and we'll confirm availability at your exact location.

Trusted by homes across India

Every Pronto Professional completes a formal training programme and a background check before their first booking. Service quality is monitored continuously through ratings and feedback after every visit. 10,00,000+ homes served. 13,000+ Pronto Pros on the platform.

Support and policies

Customer support is open 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. on +91 9910483315 or help@withpronto.com. Pay in-app via UPI, debit or credit cards, or wallets. No cash payments. Cancel any booking from the app before the Pro arrives. Cancellations made well in advance are at no charge; cancellations close to the booking time may carry a small charge to cover the Pro's reserved slot. If a visit falls short, contact us and we'll send a replacement Pro or refund where appropriate. You only pay per visit, and there is no setup charge for recurring bookings.

Open the app and tell us what your home needs.

name: X
description:
X (formerly Twitter) is a social media app where you can follow breaking news, live events, and trending topics as they happen. Sports, tech, music, politics: whatever you're into, the conversation starts here, raw and unfiltered.

It's also a place to be heard. Post your take on the day's news, go live, and grow an audience for whatever you create. Millions of people come to X every day to find out what's happening and talk about it.


WHAT YOU CAN DO ON X

- Follow breaking news – Get news from around the world before it hits the headlines, with real-time updates on trending topics and viral conversations.
- Post to a global community – Share your thoughts, photos, and videos. Join millions of users shaping public dialogue across social, cultural, and political conversations.
- Ask Grok – Grok is the AI assistant powered by X's real-time data. Ask Grok to summarize trending news, explain videos, or give you more context about posts. Grok also powers the photo and video editing tools in the app.
- Create original videos – The built-in Video Editor and Recorder lets you shoot, add multi-language captions, apply green screen effects, and post pro-level content directly in the app.
- Go live on video – Stream a concert, a live game, or your thoughts on a hot topic, and keep your audience engaged with enhanced livestream tools.
- Watch video and podcasts – From live breaking news and sports clips to podcasts and gaming sessions up to 3 hours long. Many of the world's leading voices in comedy, gaming, podcasting, and politics share their content on X.
- Host live audio with Spaces – Spaces is X's audio feature for hosting discussions, holding interviews, or starting your next live podcast.
- Message privately – Connect and chat with friends, followers, customers, or collaborators through Direct Messages.
- Pin Custom Timelines – Custom Timelines are Grok-powered topic feeds you can pin for the topics you follow most.
- Turn on Priority Notifications – Priority Notifications surface your key interactions first.
- Open your History tab – The History tab is one unified place for your bookmarks, likes, videos, and articles.
- Subscribe to X Premium – X Premium unlocks a blue checkmark, boosted visibility, prioritized replies, fewer ads, longer videos, and post editing. It also gives you creator revenue sharing and the ability to offer exclusive content to subscribers.

WHO X IS FOR

X is for people who follow breaking news and live events in real time, for sports, tech, music, and politics fans, for creators and podcasters who stream and create original video content for an audience, and for anyone building a community around gaming, entertainment, crypto, entrepreneurship, or tech.
